fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant lost a gold chain of about 3 sovereigns to a person who grabbed it near Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex and ran. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2025-03-01, while the incident was placed on 2025-02-27 around 15:05 hrs. The complainant, Lavanya Ammal, provided the contact number 9000000175. The complaint mentions Hariharan Palanisamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000463, in connection with the events. Anitha Raman (9000000267) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect reportedly grabbed the chain and fled the spot quickly.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, gold chain, mobile number, shopping complex, afternoon, suspect, witness
